name: Atelier Kinetik — AI-First Design & Motion Registry
license: Code MIT · Typography OFL (per-font, via Google Fonts) · Brand marks reserved
summary: 60 curated Google Fonts, 24 studio pairings, 3 fluid clamp() type scales, 6 audited semantic light/dark token systems, hue-locked 50-950 WCAG 2.1 scales, 12 named motion laws, 12 production micro-interaction snippets and 16 dependency-free 60fps canvas hero backgrounds.
audience: AI coding agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Manus, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, Emergent)
usage: Fetch /llms.txt first for orientation, then pull only the assets you need from this manifest.
Every snippet in snippets{} is copy-paste ready and self-contained (CSS+JS inline).
Every FX in fx[] is a standalone .html — iframe it, inline it, or lift the <canvas> + <script> into your build.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: every Kinetik asset ships an opt-out path. Keep it when you copy.

magnetic-button.name: Magnetic Button
magnetic-button.description: Button that leans toward the cursor with a spring-like settle. Pairs with .chip / .btn-flame styling.
magnetic-button.code:
<button class="ak-magnetic" data-strength="0.32">Claim the tier</button>
<style>
  .ak-magnetic {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 0;
    background: #FF3D00; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ak-magnetic { transform: none !important; transition: none; } }
</style>
<script>
  (() => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    document.querySelectorAll(".ak-magnetic").forEach((el) => {
      const strength = parseFloat(el.dataset.strength || "0.3");
      el.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = (e.clientX - (r.left + r.width / 2)) * strength;
        const y = (e.clientY - (r.top + r.height / 2)) * strength;
        el.style.transform = "translate(" + x.toFixed(1) + "px," + y.toFixed(1) + "px)";
      });
      el.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { el.style.transform = "translate(0px, 0px)"; });
    });
  })();
</script>

reveal-on-scroll.name: Reveal on Scroll (IO, Zero CLS)
reveal-on-scroll.description: IntersectionObserver reveals with transform/opacity only — no reflow, no CLS, reduced-motion safe.
reveal-on-scroll.code:
<section class="ak-reveal">Editorial content…</section>
<style>
  .ak-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px);
    transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }
  .ak-reveal.is-in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ak-reveal { transition: none; opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
</style>
<script>
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add("is-in"); io.unobserve(entry.target); } });
  }, { rootMargin: "0px 0px -12% 0px", threshold: 0.08 });
  document.querySelectorAll(".ak-reveal").forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
</script>
